methods.name: rpc.ping
methods.summary: Ping the server.

result.name: result
result.description: Returns "pong" if successful.

methods.name: rpc.methods
methods.summary: List all available methods.

result.name: methods
result.description: An array of method names (e.g. "rpc.ping").

methods.name: map.replace
methods.summary: Replace the current map with a new one.

params.name: map
params.description: The new map in JSON format

result.name: result
result.description: No result is returned if successful.

methods.name: map.start_in_area
methods.summary: Trigger mowing to start in a specific working area.

params.name: area_index
params.description: Zero-based index into the type=='mow' filtered area list (matches robot_state.current_area).

result.name: result
result.description: No result is returned if successful.

methods.name: mower.return_home
methods.summary: Tell the mower to return to its docking station, regardless of the current state.

result.name: result
result.description: Acknowledgement of the dispatched COMMAND_HOME service call.

methods.name: meta.rpc.ping
methods.summary: Ping the meta server.

result.name: result
result.description: Returns "pong" if successful.

methods.name: meta.config.schema
methods.summary: Get the configuration schema.

result.name: result
result.description: Returns the JSON schema for the configuration.

methods.name: meta.config.defaults
methods.summary: Get the default configuration values.

result.name: result
result.description: Returns an object where each key is a relative path and the value is the content of a YAML file as a string.

additionalProperties.description: Content of a YAML file as a string

schema.description: Keys are relative file paths, values are YAML file contents as strings

methods.name: meta.config.get
methods.summary: Read the live mower_config.sh as a flat key/value object.

result.name: result
result.description: Object whose keys are environment-variable names and values are their current string values.

methods.name: meta.config.set
methods.summary: Apply a set of changes to mower_config.sh atomically.

params.name: changes
params.description: Object with the keys to write. Existing keys are updated in place; new keys are appended.

result.name: result
result.description: Counts plus the keys that were actually written (`updated_keys`) and those that were dropped (`skipped_keys`). Each skipped entry carries a reason: `readonly` (x-readonly-via-ui), `env-source` / `ros-source` (wrong write path), `unknown` (not in schema or mapping), `no-yaml-path` (schema entry without a target) or `out-of-range` (numeric value outside the schema's minimum/maximum).

methods.name: params.get_many
methods.summary: Read multiple ROS parameters at once. Names are filtered against the schema's x-ros-param whitelist on the server.

params.name: names
params.description: List of fully-qualified ROS parameter names to read.

result.name: result
result.description: Object containing the read values keyed by parameter name. Names not in the whitelist or not currently set on the parameter server are absent or null.

methods.name: params.set
methods.summary: Set a single ROS parameter, optionally triggering dynamic_reconfigure on the owning node.

params.name: name
params.description: Fully-qualified ROS parameter name, e.g. /mower_logic/foo.

params.name: value
params.description: New value (boolean, integer, number or string).

result.name: result
result.description: No result is returned if successful.

methods.name: schedule.list
methods.summary: List all configured mowing schedules.

result.name: schedules
result.description: Array of schedule entries.

methods.name: schedule.upsert
methods.summary: Insert or update a schedule. The ID is generated server-side when missing.

params.name: schedule
params.description: Schedule definition.

result.name: schedule
result.description: The persisted schedule (with the assigned id).

methods.name: schedule.delete
methods.summary: Remove a schedule by id.

params.name: id
params.description: Schedule id to delete.

result.name: result
result.description: No result is returned if successful.

methods.name: system.restart_service
methods.summary: Restart a whitelisted systemd unit on the mower host.

params.name: service
params.description: Service name. Defaults to the main mower service.

result.name: result
result.description: Acknowledgement. May time out if the responding service restarts itself.

methods.name: system.reboot
methods.summary: Reboot the host machine (Raspberry Pi).

params.name: delay_s
params.description: Delay in seconds before the reboot is issued (0–30, default 1). Lets the RPC response reach the client before the host goes down.

result.name: result
result.description: Acknowledgement. The MQTT connection will drop shortly after this returns.

methods.name: system.stats
methods.summary: Read live host metrics: CPU %, RAM, CPU temperature, root-filesystem usage, uptime.

result.name: result
result.description: Snapshot of host metrics. Individual fields are omitted when not available (e.g. when running outside a Pi or without pid: host).

disk_total_bytes.description: Size of the host root filesystem (SD/eMMC).

methods.name: system.docker_prune
methods.summary: Remove unused Docker images on the host (`docker image prune -af`).

result.name: result
result.description: Result of the prune. `reclaimed_bytes` is parsed from the docker output and may be 0 when nothing was eligible for removal.

methods.name: logs.tail
methods.summary: Read recent log lines from a node or 'all' sources on the mower host.

params.name: source
params.description: Source filter. 'all' aggregates every known node.

params.name: lines
params.description: Number of trailing lines to return (50–5000).

result.name: result
result.description: List of normalised log entries.

methods.name: telemetry.list_sessions
methods.summary: Enumerate recorded mowing telemetry sessions.

result.name: result
result.description: List of recorded sessions with summary metadata.

methods.name: telemetry.get_session
methods.summary: Fetch the recorded telemetry samples for a single mowing session.

params.name: id
params.description: Session id from telemetry.list_sessions.

params.name: stride
params.description: Decimation factor (return every N-th sample). Default 1 = full resolution.

result.name: result
result.description: Sample stream for the session.

methods.name: imu.calibrate_level
methods.summary: Treat the mower's current pose as level: derive the IMU mounting roll/pitch and gyro-bias from a 2 s sample window and persist them under ll.services.imu.* via meta.config.set's atomic write pipeline.
methods.description: The mower must be on flat ground and motionless. The RPC averages ~200 samples of /ll/imu/data_raw, rejects the call (ERROR_INTERNAL with a 'MOWER_NOT_STILL: …' message and JSON payload) when the per-axis stddev exceeds the still-mower threshold, and otherwise writes the new offsets to the user YAML and pushes them into ros::param so the orientation filter picks them up at its next 1 Hz reload tick.

result.name: result
result.description: The newly persisted offsets plus the statistics from the recording window.

methods.name: events.list
methods.summary: List recent lifecycle events from the mower's notification ring buffer.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of events to return (1–500, default 200). Newest events come first.

params.name: since_ts
params.description: Return only events with ts_ms strictly greater than this value (epoch ms).

params.name: severity_min
params.description: Filter to events at or above this severity.

params.name: types
params.description: If set, only return events whose type is in this list.

result.name: result
result.description: List of events plus the current unread count.

methods.name: events.ack
methods.summary: Mark a single event as acknowledged.

params.name: id
params.description: Event id to acknowledge.

result.name: result
result.description: ok=false when the id was not found in the ring buffer.

methods.name: events.ack_all
methods.summary: Mark every event in the ring buffer as acknowledged.

result.name: result
result.description: Acknowledgement.

methods.name: events.clear
methods.summary: Drop every event from the ring buffer and from disk.

result.name: result
result.description: Acknowledgement.

methods.name: sensors.history
methods.summary: Replay the in-memory sample ring buffer for one sensor (~1 h @ 2 Hz).

params.name: sensor_id
params.description: Sensor id matching SensorInfo.sensor_id.

params.name: since_ts
params.description: Return only samples with ts_ms strictly greater than this value (epoch ms).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum samples to return (1–7200, default 7200). Trailing window — most-recent samples are kept.

result.name: result
result.description: Samples in chronological order (oldest first).

methods.name: sensors.history_bulk
methods.summary: Replay history for every sensor with a non-empty ring buffer in one round-trip.

params.name: since_ts
params.description: Return only samples with ts_ms strictly greater than this value (epoch ms).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum samples per sensor (1–7200, default 7200).

result.name: result
result.description: Samples per sensor id, oldest first.

details.description: Optional structured payload. Empty object when not provided.

acked.description: Whether the user has acknowledged this event.

ts_ms.description: Wall-clock epoch milliseconds the sample was recorded at.

timezone.description: IANA time zone name the rrule is interpreted in (e.g. 'Europe/Vienna'). Defaults to 'UTC' on the server when missing for legacy entries.

next_run.description: Read-only. ISO 8601 timestamp (with offset) of the upcoming occurrence. Omitted when the schedule is disabled or has no future occurrence.

last_fired_at.description: Read-only. ISO 8601 timestamp of the last successful firing. Omitted when the schedule has never fired.

last_skip_reason.description: Read-only. Reason the most recent due occurrence was skipped. Omitted when no skip has been recorded.

last_skip_at.description: Read-only. ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent skip. Omitted when no skip has been recorded.
